purpose: Michi detail refinement proposals, not applied to production sprites

prompts.name: 01-classic-refined
prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: character redesign proposal for Sobra mobile app. Edit target: image 1 is the existing Michi cat, whose identity must be preserved. Supporting style references: images 2 and 3 show the newer app animals; use their polished, detailed pixel-art rendering, not their animal anatomy or colors. Create ONE full-body seated Michi, centered at a generous size on a genuinely transparent background, square canvas, comfortable margin around ears, feet, tail. Keep Michi's dark navy blue fur, large golden amber eyes, exactly three narrow cream forehead stripes, upright ear on viewer-left with peach interior, folded ear on viewer-right with tiny cream highlight, cream muzzle, salmon nose, cream chest bib, cream toes, navy striped tail curving upward on viewer-right with cream tip, teal collar and square golden tag. Preserve the friendly quiet personality, recognizable silhouette and big-head small-body proportions. High quality hand-crafted pixel illustration with coherent pixel clusters, dark outline and stepped edges, like the supporting app sprites. No photorealism, no 3D, no vector, no smooth airbrush, no additional objects, no text, no labels, no multiple characters, no sprite sheet. Readable as a small app character.
Direction 1: faithful remaster. Keep the original front-facing pose, exact body shape, short fur and original proportions as closely as possible. Add controlled small fur clusters on cheeks, forehead, chest and forelegs, 3-5 levels of navy fur shading, gentle rounded face volume, nuanced amber irises and tiny catchlights. Refine cream muzzle fur edges, tiny paw separation, folded-ear crease, teal collar thickness and subtle gold tag glint. This is the closest option to the original, only a craftsmanship upgrade. Avoid shaggy fur or enlarged cheeks.
